added_lines: Solemnity of Our Lord Jesus Christ, Universal King Jesus, the Lord of all creation cared so much for those in his domain, that he was willing to die, in order to care for them. Those who will finally belong to him, will be those who have shared his care for the hungry, the naked, the lost, the cripp led and the strays of this world. New members welcome. Diocesan Youth Ministry Envelope Collection The Youth Ministry Special Collection will take place this weekend November 14th and 15th, 2026. It is important for to support and encourage our young people in every way we can and encourage them to take part in their local Parish.
This collection directly supports the work of Sheila Kelleher, our Diocesan Youth Ministry Coordinator, and the many volunteers dedicated to n urturing faith among our youth.
